chunks.arabic_text: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ، عَنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ الصَّفَّارِ، عَنِ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ، عَنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، عَنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورَ قَالَ

translations.en: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Abdallah ibn Sinan, from Ibn Abi Ya'fur who said:

chunks.arabic_text: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ إِذْ أَقْبَلَ عِيسَى بْنُ أَبِي مَنْصُورٍ فَقَالَ لِي: إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَنْظُرَ خَيْرًا فِي الدُّنْيَا خَيْرًا فِي الْآخِرَةِ فَانْظُرْ إِلَيْهِ

translations.en: I was with Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) when Isa ibn Abi Mansur approached, and he said to me: If you wish to see someone who is the best in the world and the best in the hereafter, then look at him.

en.summary: This narration from *Al-Faqih* highlights the high spiritual status of Isa ibn Abi Mansur, a prominent companion of Imam al-Sadiq (AS), serving as a benchmark for identifying true virtue (*khayr*) in both worldly conduct and eternal reward. In Shia scholarly tradition, such endorsements underscore the importance of recognizing righteous individuals as guides, linking their earthly excellence to their ultimate success in the Hereafter.
en.seo_question: Who is Isa ibn Abi Mansur and why is he considered the best in the world and the hereafter?

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (Imam al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)
key_terms.عِيسَى بْنُ أَبِي مَنْصُورٍ: Isa ibn Abi Manshur, a companion of the Imams
